What the selected frozen DMG page 78/0025 does say, under the heading "Permanent residence in a care home" and the sub-heading "Claimants who have no partner (including self- funders)", is that at DMG 78088 an additional amount for the severely disabled "is applicable to a person who is permanently in a\n\ncare home if all the conditions are satisfied", with a Note that this will normally be self funding claimants and will also include residents where AA or DLA/PiP payment continues for the first four weeks after admission. That is a component-level applicability rule for one branch (no partner), not an award-ending or award-continuing rule. Separately, DMG 78089 and the selected SPC Regulations 2002 reg 5(1)(b) address household membership treatment, and DMG 78270 addresses only the housing-costs additional amount. A historical amendment page (Vol 14 Amendment 40, captured role historical-amendment-not-current-rules) links permanent care-home accommodation for a no-partner claimant to the end of an assessed income period under reg 12(c), but reg 12 itself was omitted under the node and byte budgets.

abstentions: I cannot state that Pension Credit stops when a person moves permanently into a care home as a self-funder, nor that it continues; no selected record addresses cessation of the award, and silence cannot supply a missing condition.

I cannot conclude that a self-funding permanent care-home resident qualifies for the severe-disability additional amount: DMG 78088 is expressly conditional on all conditions being satisfied and self-funding is only described as the normal case.
I cannot transfer the DMG 78088 no-partner rule to a member of a couple, nor apply the DMG 78089 couple/household statement to a claimant with no partner.
I cannot extend the DMG 78270 housing-costs exclusion, or the four-week AA/DLA/PiP continuation note, to the whole Pension Credit award or to Guarantee Credit or Savings Credit generally.
I cannot treat the assessed income period ending event on the Vol 14 Amendment 40 page as an entitlement or payment cessation rule, nor as current guidance.
I cannot confirm current law, commencement, amendment history or territorial extent for any selected statutory unit, nor reconcile the requested 2026-09-20 version with an applicable date.

I cannot calculate or estimate any award, request or assume personal circumstances, or give an individual outcome; neither the project concept text nor this analysis is specialist approval or a complete legal answer.
